source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius large rock on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Rock_3 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the tree, tree-pine, tree-autumn and bush entries, so they read as one set. Of the pack's fourteen rocks (Rock_1 to Rock_7 and Rock_Moss_1 to Rock_Moss_7, all rendered) it reads best as one large boulder: a broad base tapering to a rounded crown, about as wide as it is tall (1.31 x 1.42 m footprint), where Rock_1 is a thin standing stone, Rock_2 a small cobble and Rock_4 to Rock_7 long, flat-topped slabs. It suits a garden or shrine stone. The plain rock was chosen over its moss twins because no colour script has a green; mapping moss to a script colour would read as paint, not moss. Height 1.2 m: a large garden or shrine boulder is about 1 to 1.5 m, chest height on a 1.6 m person. Colours on indigo, as the stone lantern: stone moon (the source's blue-grey #878b96 lit by the moon) shading to sky. Smooth shading kept: with flat facets the shade fell as one band along the base and the boulder read as a cut-out. Static: no clips.
